correctionReason: The earlier review over-weighted source pose/layout (two diagonal pieces) versus the approved horizontal recomposition and therefore risked treating legitimate reorientation/overlap as topology change. The attached A/B evidence shows the generated candidate tracks the deterministic factual recomposition far more closely than the later fantasy-hardware regime.
scope: Independent factual review must compare exact source landmarks after neutralizing allowed pose/composition transforms. Text, metrics, self-declared PASS labels and regenerated source depictions inside producer reports remain non-authoritative.
currentObservations: The reviewed candidate is visually much closer to the deterministic factual H45 recomposition than the later fantasy-hardware outputs.
The previous raw-source-layout comparison is insufficient to prove a topology mismatch because horizontal reorientation and factual-group overlap are allowed transformations in this case.
The candidate should be retained as a positive-control candidate for the producer's high-adherence regime, not promoted as a faithful variant yet.
A new review must compare pose-invariant landmarks: piece count, per-piece hole/slot sequence, terminal structures, fittings/stops, rail proportions and relative overlap after alignment.

negativeControlContrast.description: Later outputs repeatedly collapse to an obviously invented roller/rail archetype with fantasy mechanical features. Those remain clear factual failures and should not be grouped with this candidate.
negativeControlContrast.researchUse: Use the good candidate and fantasy archetype as positive/negative controls when characterizing producer mode switching and reference adherence.

researchConsequence: Normal-size visual plausibility remains insufficient, but neither may pose/layout difference be used as a topology proxy.
Factual gates for allowed reorientation must be landmark-based and pose-invariant.
The producer appears capable of at least two qualitatively different regimes: high reference adherence and fantasy prototype substitution.
The next question is what controls or predicts the regime switch, not whether the capability is uniformly poor.
